description: Source code implementing mesh state binding functions for Bluetooth Mesh models, including temperature and lightness constraints, target setting, and value conversions.

methods.name: ceiling
methods.description: Calculates the ceiling of a float number, returning the smallest integer greater than or equal to the input.

methods.name: actual_to_linear
methods.description: Converts an actual lightness value to a linear scale using a quadratic function.

methods.name: linear_to_actual
methods.description: Converts a linear lightness value back to actual scale using square root.

methods.name: constrain_lightness
methods.description: Constrains a lightness value within the device's defined min and max range.

methods.name: constrain_target_lightness2
methods.description: Adjusts the target lightness based on mesh model specification constraints.

methods.name: constrain_temperature
methods.description: Constrains a temperature value within the device's temperature range.

methods.name: light_ctl_temp_to_level
methods.description: Converts temperature to a level value based on mesh model formula.

methods.name: level_to_light_ctl_temp
methods.description: Converts a level value back to temperature using mesh model formula.

methods.name: set_target
methods.description: Sets target values for different mesh model parameters based on type and data pointer.

methods.name: get_current
methods.description: Retrieves current state value for specified type.

methods.name: get_target
methods.description: Retrieves target state value for specified type.
